prompt:
Game enemy lineup sheet: TEN different melee enemy sprites of one poison clan arranged in a strict grid of 5 columns by 2 rows on ONE image, every character in its own invisible cell of equal size, each cell one fifth of the image width and one half of the image height. The top row holds the five weakest creatures and the bottom row the five strongest, each row growing from the left to the right: the creatures get taller, heavier and more armoured with rank. Each is a chunky grim fantasy cartoon character, never cute, never a mascot. All TEN are in SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera, facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the image, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body, standing UPRIGHT in a calm ready stance with both feet on ONE horizontal ground line, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward. Every character has TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH, a face built from the fewest bold shapes, TWO BOLD GLOWING eye shapes with no pupils, skin in two flat tones. Layout rules: each character is VERY SMALL inside its cell and centered horizontally in it, with the soles of the feet on a line at 70% of the cell height, a very wide empty background space on both sides of every character and an empty band above the head; the ten characters are far apart, clearly separated by empty background, and no weapon, hand or cloak ever reaches the neighbouring cell. Relative sizes by rank: characters 1 and 2 are tiny, about one third the height of characters 6, 7 and 8; characters 3, 4 and 5 are small, about two thirds of that height; characters 9 and 10 are huge, about one and a half times that height.
TOP ROW, left to right:
1. SPORELING, tiny, no weapon: a mushroom walker about 2 heads tall whose head is a huge round cap, a short pale stalk body, stubby arms and legs, empty hands. Cap in purple, spotted with lime dots. Pale cream stalk #D9CBA2 with shadow #A89A74.
2. SLIME IMP, tiny: a small imp with slimy olive skin, two small curved horns, big pointed ears, holding ONE tiny curved thorn stinger in the hand on the LEFT side of the image, thick drips of lime goo from its chin. Skin olive #7C8A4A with shadow #55612F and light #A9B66B. Horns purple.
3. BOG TOADLING, small: a toad-like biped with a wide flat mouth, bulging eyes, a round bloated belly, short bowed legs, ONE short knobbly wooden club held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Skin sickly olive-green #6B8040 with shadow #4A5A2A and light #9DB264, belly pale #C8C48A. Club #6A4430.
4. PLAGUE RAT, small: a ratman with a pointed snout, big round ears, a long thin tail held low, a tattered purple vest, ONE rusty short dagger held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Fur dull grey-brown #7A6A5A with shadow #54483C. Vest purple. Dagger rust #8A5A3A with a lime-stained edge.
5. FUNGAL ACOLYTE, small: a hooded cultist in a short robe with a cluster of mushrooms growing on one shoulder, ONE small curved sickle dripping lime goo, held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Robe purple. Mushrooms cream with purple caps. Skin olive #7C8A4A. Sickle steel #8A8C8E.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right:
6. TOADSPAWN BRUTE, medium, brawny: a muscular toad warrior about 3 heads tall with a barrel chest, huge fists, a wide mouth with two fangs, ONE oversized club topped with a big mushroom cap held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Skin olive-green #6B8040 with shadow #4A5A2A and light #9DB264. Straps purple. Cap purple with lime dots.
7. PLAGUE DOCTOR, medium, slender: a tall thin plague doctor with a long curved beak mask with two glowing lime eye lenses, a wide-brim hat, a long flared coat, ONE broad bone-saw cleaver held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Coat and hat purple. Mask bone cream #D9CBA2. Gloves leather #6A4430.
8. BILE KNIGHT, medium, brawny: a knight in rusted plate armour with a crested helm, two glowing lime eye slits, thick lime goo dripping from the joints, ONE broad sword with a wide blade held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Armour rusted purple-grey. Sword steel #8A8C8E with shadow #5B5E62.
9. BLOAT OGRE, huge: a gigantic ogre with a tiny head, a huge swollen belly covered in glowing pustules that ooze lime goo, thick arms, ONE huge cleaver held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. Skin olive #7C8A4A with shadow #55612F and light #A9B66B. Loincloth purple. Cleaver rust #8A5A3A and steel #8A8C8E.
10. SWAMP TROLL, huge, no weapon: a hunched giant troll with long heavy arms, huge fists, covered in fungus, mushrooms and glowing lime moss, empty hands. Skin dark olive-purple #5A4A6A. Fungus cream and lime. Moss lime #B8E04A.
COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: the whole clan shares ONE dominant hue, a purple (hue about 285 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #3A1F5C, base #6B3FA0, light #9C6FCF, top highlight #CDB0EE, for the caps, the clothes, the vests, the coats and the armour. ONE warm family for the skin, the leather and the wood: olive skin #7C8A4A with shadow #55612F and light #A9B66B, leather #6A4430 and #4A2E22. ONE accent family, toxic lime #B8E04A with shadow #7FA01F, ONLY on the goo drips, the glowing eyes and the pustules. Rules: large areas are mid values; only the eyes and the goo are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline of every character is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. The higher the rank, the deeper the purple and the more armour and goo.
Everything stays inside the frame with a margin on every side, every weapon tip at least 20% below the top edge of its cell. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no grid lines, no cell borders, no numbers, no text, no scenery. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.
Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky cartoon enemy illustration, each character designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded volumes, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, hands and weapons enlarged and legs shrunk. Flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones with the large areas in MID values; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots on large surfaces. Medium detail only: bold simple shapes, no fine engraving, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
